title: Understanding Visualizations
text: When considering visualizations for a single numerical variable like price, think about how you can display the distribution or frequency of the data. Common options include histograms and box plots.

title: Exploring Bar Charts
text: Bar charts are typically used for categorical data. Since price is numerical, consider if a bar chart is the best choice for showing variations in price.
